title: Train and save a small tabular model
note: Synthetic CSV teaching fixture. The first six rows train one-predictor OLS; the final three are an ordered, deterministic holdout, not a random split. Only training rows enter Fit. Metrics are calculated when run and do not establish real-world performance or causation. Requires published GoBook v0.2.0.

cells.code:
// 1. Strict named numeric columns; synthetic observations in explicit order.
source := "hours,score
1,3.2
2,4.8
3,7.1
4,8.9
5,11.2
6,12.8
7,15.1
8,16.9
9,19.2
"
data, err := tabular.ReadCSV(strings.NewReader(source), "hours", "score")
if err != nil { panic(err) }
train, heldout, err := tabular.Split(data, 6)
if err != nil { panic(err) }
fmt.Printf("Ordered split: %d training rows, %d held-out rows
", len(train.X), len(heldout.X))
